model_observation.scope: Actual omitted model overrides mean inherited session defaults; explicit experimental requests, where present, remain requests. The host does not expose authenticated resolved backend identities.

metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: One unrandomized shared-host session execution with one bounded simulated ui_integrator role; native resolved model/role identities, tokens, billing and context metrics remain unavailable. The actual child request omits the participant prompt file terminal LF. Completed execution does not imply owner acceptance. Prescribed top-right feedback temporarily covers header utilities and the inherited 390px Customize/Save overlap remains. Static views and actual timer-driven interactions do not establish uninterrupted natural-speed playback; early pending samples may precede native fade completion. Original videos are retained but were not viewed. Real-device touch, auditory screen-reader behavior, full gallery navigation and exact deployed upstream commit remain unverified. Capacity failures and corrected harness failures are preserved. Post-resume notification-export time is not actual engine completion or active duration.
